name: Sunset Ridge Cabin
tagline: Two-bedroom A-frame on four wooded acres
description: A timber A-frame set back from the road on four wooded acres, twenty minutes from Leavenworth. Two bedrooms up under the eaves, a wood-burning stove downstairs, and a deck that catches the last of the light over the ridge. Quiet enough that the loudest thing most evenings is the creek.
highlights: Wood-burning stove and a stocked log store
Deck with ridge views and a fire pit
Four private acres, no neighbours in sight
amenities: Wifi throughout, weaker past the fire pit
Free off-street parking for two cars
Wood-burning stove and electric baseboard heat
Smart TV, bring your own streaming logins
houseRules: Dogs welcome (up to two); no cats
No smoking anywhere on the property
